biography:
As a Senior Development Lead at Stream Data Centers, my expertise in operations and infrastructure construction has been pivotal in executing large-scale projects while providing useful input into programmatic operations. Our team prioritizes safety and quality, ensuring that all ventures are completed within schedule, scope, and budget.

While continuing to hone my skills in operational planning and execution, my teams have successfully navigated complex challenges and maintained exemplary customer relations within commercial, industrial, and utility markets. 

With a growth mindset and commitment to operational excellence, my leadership continues to drive progress and innovation in construction and development.
